description: This file contains two functions, update_status and update_percent_complete, which manipulate DOM elements related to task progress and status. It appears to be part of a module named ProjectTask in a CRM system, handling the UI logic for task progress updates.

methods.name: update_status(percent_complete)
methods.description: Updates the 'status' DOM element based on the given percentage complete; labels as 'Not Started', 'In Progress', or 'Completed'. Also validates percentage input.

methods.name: update_percent_complete(status)
methods.description: Sets the 'percent_complete' DOM element based on the 'status' provided; assigns values '0', '50', or '100'.
